meta.title: [MTP] Improve performance of validating command line options
meta.body_summary: Optimize CommandLineOptionsValidator by replacing O(n²) LINQ operations with HashSet/Dictionary lookups, reducing memory allocations, and adding PerformanceSensitive attribute (later removed).

perf_labels.notes: Copilot performed algorithmic refactoring; maintainer gave extensive style feedback but never approved or requested performance evidence, leading to closure.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: A small, focused single-file change (219 lines) typical of micro-optimisation PRs. Closed without merge after many style-focused review rounds, suggesting maintainer never intended to accept the perf change.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer repeatedly requested explicit types instead of var, specific whitespace adjustments (blank lines, indentation), and indentation fixes; no comments on performance improvement or benchmarking.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce algorithmic complexity from O(n²) to O(n) in validation methods, lower memory allocations, and improve string trimming efficiency.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without approval after multiple rounds of style-only review; maintainer never acknowledged or evaluated the performance benefit.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot delivered a correct algorithmic improvement, but the maintainer engaged exclusively on coding style conventions (explicit types, whitespace) without evaluating performance, resulting in closure without merge.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer Youssef1313 reviewed the code meticulously through dozens of inline comments, focusing on style (var/explicit types, blank lines) rather than verifying the performance claims.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes a profiling screenshot but no numeric before/after metrics or benchmark scripts; no evidence of maintainer reproducing the claimed improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix cycle beyond style adjustments.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored CommandLineOptionsValidator to use HashSet for O(1) name checks instead of LINQ Intersect/Union, replaced GroupBy with Dictionary for duplication detection, optimized ToTrimmedString to avoid unnecessary allocations, removed expensive LINQ operations, and added (later removed) PerformanceSensitive attribute.
change_trajectory: Initial commit applied algorithmic optimizations and added PerformanceSensitiveAttribute.
Per maintainer feedback, removed PerformanceSensitiveAttribute and Roslyn.Utilities import.
Multiple rounds of style edits: explicit type replacements, whitespace/blank-line adjustments.
PR closed without merge after sustained style-only interaction.

review_signals.summary: Requested removal of PerformanceSensitiveAttribute and related Roslyn.Utilities using.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot removed the attribute and import.

review_signals.summary: Requested replacing var with explicit types in foreach loops.
Multiple suggestions for blank lines and indentation fixes.
Reported being blocked by firewall rules while working on feedback.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with perf refactoring and profiling screenshot.
Maintainer rapidly started commenting (within ~19 minutes), focusing on removing PerformanceSensitiveAttribute and later on style issues.
Copilot responded with many small commits addressing each style request.
After many rounds, the PR was closed without merge or approval.
